plan.goal: Find, analyze, and rank representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0070401) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0070402) activity using GO-annotated sequence retrieval, biochemical sequence analysis, ESM3 embedding, and design ranking.
assumptions: GO:0070401 encodes ADP-dependent (S)-NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity and GO:0070402 encodes NADPHX epimerase activity; these IDs match the tool-selection suggestion and are cross-checked by the literature_search node.

Reviewed (Swiss-Prot) sequences with non-IEA evidence are fetched first to maximise annotation reliability; if either set returns fewer than 5 sequences, the reviewed and exclude_iea filters should be relaxed in a follow-up run.
sequence_analysis representative_sequences output items each carry a 'sequence' string field directly usable as the ESM3 sequence input.
ESM3 is run in embedding-only mode (tracks: ['embedding']) to capture sequence-level diversity signal for ranking without incurring full structure-prediction cost.

rank_designs aggregates both sequence_analysis records and ESM3 embedding outputs; the resulting ranked_candidates list covers dehydratase and epimerase representatives in a single composite-scored ordering.
No taxonomic restriction is applied; all kingdoms are included to capture the full phylogenetic breadth of NAD(P)HX repair systems.
max_parallel: 4 for ESM3 foreach nodes is conservative and assumes 4 GPUs; increase to available GPU count for faster throughput.

success_criteria.literature_context: literature_search returns at least 5 records on NAD(P)HX repair proteins confirming GO:0070401 and GO:0070402 functional annotations
success_criteria.sequence_retrieval: go_sequences returns non-empty FASTA files for both GO:0070401 and GO:0070402 with at least 1 reviewed, non-IEA-annotated sequence each
success_criteria.biochemical_analysis: sequence_analysis produces representative_sequences, composition metrics, region annotations, and liabilities for each GO term set
success_criteria.esm3_embeddings: esm3 foreach nodes produce per_residue_embeddings_npz and confidence_scores for every representative sequence in both dehydratase and epimerase sets
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs returns a ranked_candidates list (top_k=20) covering both dehydratase and epimerase representatives with composite scores
